title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Fed blackout starts today (Nov 28–Dec 10) — no Fed commentary before Dec 9 FOMC; December hike ~94% priced; ISM Mfg Mon + NFP Fri Dec 4 carry full weight.
BTC spot ETFs: $389M fresh daily outflow today, adding to record November redemptions (~$5.8B MTD).
BTC ~-20% in November — worst monthly loss since June; weekly close Sunday key; next support ~$56,800.
